title: Zesty Canadian Cashew Mousse
description: A plant‑based, citrus‑infused mousse that uses unflavoured gelatin for a silky texture, served on a rustic tagliere with a hint of maple sweetness and a touch of cayenne for zing.
instructions: Soak the cashews in hot water for 2 minutes to soften.
Bloom the gelatin by sprinkling it over 50ml cold water and letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Blend the softened cashews with coconut milk, maple syrup, lemon juice, lime juice, sea salt, and cayenne pepper until completely smooth.
Gently heat the bloomed gelatin in a saucepan until it melts, then let it cool to room temperature.
Whisk the melted gelatin into the cashew mixture until fully incorporated and the mixture is glossy.
Pour the mousse into a rectangular tagliere and smooth the surface with a spatula.
Refrigerate the mousse for 2 hours until it sets firmly.
Before serving, sprinkle crushed pistachios over the top for texture and color.
Serve chilled, slicing into squares that match the shape of the tagliere.
